topic: GTA 6: NPCs near an early-mission bar whisper about GTA 5's Mount Chiliad bunker, jetpacks and eggs; the 2013 mural, the 2017 Doomsday Heist jetpack, and an ex-Rockstar designer saying some Easter eggs just mess with people
title: GTA 6 is still whispering about GTA 5's mountain #shorts
lines: Why are strangers in GTA 6 still talking about a GTA 5 mountain?
Early in the story, Donnie calls Jason to meet him and Brian at a bar.
On the way, players overheard locals gossiping about Mount Chiliad.
A hidden bunker, they say, full of jetpacks and eggs.
Back in 2013, GTA 5 hid a mural on that peak: a UFO, a cracked egg and a jetpack.
Fans hunted for years. A jetpack only arrived in GTA Online in 2017.
A former Rockstar designer later said some Easter eggs are just there to mess with people.
Thirteen years later, Rockstar is clearly still doing it. So, one more time:
description: GTA 6 locals are gossiping about GTA 5's most famous mystery, and Rockstar may be trolling us all over again. #gta6 #gtavi #gta5 #easteregg #shorts
